stories.title: Pandex brings European law to AI agents
stories.summary: Pandex推出了官方欧洲AI法案的MCP实现，帮助AI代理合规运行。这为自动化代理在欧洲的合法应用提供了重要支持。

stories.title: Crowdstrike and Zscaler talks highlight AI consolidation
stories.summary: 网络安全巨头Crowdstrike与Zscaler的接触凸显了行业整合趋势。面对AI驱动的高级攻击，各大公司正通过并购扩大防御能力。

stories.title: UN fails to agree on killer robots rules
stories.summary: 联合国外交官在日内瓦未能就规范自治武器达成实质协议。各方仅同意继续讨论选项，凸显了对致命机器监管的巨大分歧。

stories.title: California Nvidia probe eyes criminal violations
stories.summary: 加州对Nvidia涉嫌向中国违规销售芯片及误导投资者的调查已扩大至州法刑事违规。这显著推高了这家芯片巨头的法律风险。

stories.title: Signal restricts screenshots amid AI surveillance
stories.summary: Signal在移动端限制了截图功能以应对AI监控威胁。此举旨在保护用户隐私，防范潜在的AI图像与数据采集。

stories.title: Wall Street confronts AI market reality check
stories.summary: 华尔街正面临AI市场现实考验，Anthropic的IPO未能扭转市场情绪。高盛恐慌指数飙升至9分，反映出投资者对AI支出的担忧。

stories.title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
stories.summary: We created a list of the most notable AI agents that can live in your text messages, from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.

stories.title: Chess.com’s next move is a new hub for classic games, from mahjong to sudoku
stories.summary: Chess.com is ready to go a lot bigger than chess. After launching Gambit, a gambling-free poker site, earlier this year, the company is now adding 10 more games: backgammon, checkers, go, hearts, mahjong, shogi, sudoku,…

stories.title: Actors license faces to microdrama startups
stories.summary: 好莱坞演员开始向微短剧初创公司授权自己的AI面孔。这种源自中国的趋势引发了业界对好莱坞长远影响的担忧。

stories.title: Nvidia researchers question massive context windows
stories.summary: Nvidia研究人员认为巨型AI上下文窗口是死胡同，因其成本高且易出错。测试表明定期摘要和关键词搜索能以更低成本达到同等效果。
